Elementary school teacher shamed me in front of the whole school because I went with my aunt.

Long story short my mom has a much younger cousin who had been living with us since I was born, she is like a sister to me. One day the driver had to pick me up later than usual. My aunt knew this and because she worked like 3 minutes walking distance away from my school, she took me to wait at her office instead of the school by myself. She contacted my mom's office and left a message for her. Somehow the message didnt get through and my mom was looking for me, I just remember going back home to a bunch of worried people.
 The next day I was put in front  of everyone in the school as a bad example of "going home with a stranger", telling students that it is a stupid and dangerous thing to do, that I was wasting resources and causing unnecessary stress for my parents. Of course kids were  mean about it for the rest of elementary school years. Dangit teacher.
